name: Detect Weaponry
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

Area cone-shaped emanation
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You can detect the presence or absence of manufactured weapons within the area of effect.

The spell detects improvised weapons only if the wielder is actively intending to use them as weapons. The amount of information revealed by this spell depends on how long you concentrate on the spell within an area.

1st Round: Presence or absence of weapons
2nd Round: The number of weapons in the area
3rd Round: Specific locations of the weapons and the type of physical damage they deal.

This spell does not reveal the exact kind of weapon, nor if the weapon is magical in any way. Weapons affected by spells or effects that hide their presence such as nondetection are not detected by this spell.

Each round, you can detect within a new area as the spell. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it.
